rules: Qasr Liwan, a new town in the Marj: five missions on five new maps, from One House to The Pumps.
Bir Tarsha, a new town after Deir Amun III: five missions, from The Gate Road to Under the Fence. Sur now opens after Bir Tarsha V.
Campaign difficulty: pick Easier, Standard or Harder on the campaign board or before you start a mission. Easier caps you at two stars per mission.
Optional mission challenges, such as Whole Picture, Quiet Souk and Blind Build, are marked on the board and in the after-action report.
Free play now lets you play the Sarim: choose your side on the Free play screen.
Field works are now on by default when you play the KDF in Free play.
Versus: play the computer in 25 of the 31 map, side and win-mode combinations; a Sarim side is open only on the two Wadi Tarfan maps.
Versus: field works are now a room option in KDF v KDF annihilation.
The computer opponent now builds units, defends its ground and holds income zones.
Versus chat now hides slurs and masks strong language.
Beit Sahwan IV: fifteen civilians to save, and a new secondary to bring back the four hostages.
Civilians reaching safety, or being taken, now show as one climbing line instead of a flood of messages.
Holding ground now pays logistics in Beit Sahwan II, Deir Amun III and Wadi Halam III.
Missions and maps load on demand, so the game starts faster and uses less memory.
A browser without graphics acceleration now gets a one-time offer to switch to the Low graphics preset.
Clearer names and descriptions across units and maps, including the Charge Squad, satchel charges, one-way drones and the Shachaf scout.
fixes: Leaving a mission while it was still loading its save no longer leaves the old battlefield running.
Save and quit no longer writes a save, or brings back a dropped one, if you leave mid-save.
